correctness.rationale: For every k>=1, a=1/(2+sqrt(2-1/k)), t=1-2a satisfies t²=a²(2-1/k). Proposed positive definite A has spectra u=at/(1+t) of multiplicity 2(k-1), w=a/2 and z=at/2. Orthogonal block diagonalization and algebra of the defining quadratic give coordinate facet variances a² and comparison facet variance t². Normalized support contacts are therefore exact. Positive John weights 1-t=2a (coordinate facets) and 2t/k (k² cross facets) satisfy zero first moment and second moment A^-1, certifying global unique John ellipsoid; volume follows from eigenvalue product. k=1 triangle checked as boundary; symbolic polynomial remainder and separate scalar consistency corroborate all-k proof.
residual_risks: Finite k<=60 numerical corroboration is not proof, global John identities are.
